report: Analyzed A-greedy (ngram-mod defaults): all 4 phases done with spec ON + mmproj + q4_0 KV + --parallel 2 on :8089 — this confirms the §3 static verdict (draft_n>0 rows + timing lines in server logs, no rejection, VRAM 9507 MiB).
